meaning:
ζευκτήριος, -α -ον
(ζεύγνυμι),
fit for joining. As subst.,
(a) ζευκτήριον, τό = ζυγόν, a yoke;
(b) ζευκτηρία, -ας, ἡ = ζεύγλη, the crossbar of a double rudder: Act.27:40 (found nowhere else).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Casting off the anchors, they left them in the sea, at the same time untying the rudder ropes. Hoisting up the foresail to the wind, they made for the beach.
